internal_external_issues.issue_title: Climate Change – Increasing ambient temperature, irregular rainfall, humidity fluctuations and extreme weather conditions may affect manufac
internal_external_issues.description: Climate Change – Increasing ambient temperature, irregular rainfall, humidity fluctuations and extreme weather conditions may affect manufacturing operations, storage conditions of raw materials, machinery performance, utility availability, employee health & safety, logistics and delivery schedules.
internal_external_issues.effect_on_qms: Variation in product quality due to changes in raw material and process conditions. Increased machine breakdowns and maintenance requirements. Delay in procurement, production, and export shipments. Increased manufacturing and operational costs. Risk of customer dissatisfaction due to delayed delivery or non-conforming products.
internal_external_issues.action_taken: Maintain risk & opportunity register for climate-related operational risks. Monitor preventive maintenance schedules through ERP Next. Plan and monitor production schedules to minimize disruptions. Record equipment breakdowns, CAs, and maint. history. Monitor inventory levels of critical raw materials and safety stock to avoid shortages.
CRM, Selling, and Support modules for requirement capture, order tracking, and feedback management
ERP Next documentation and record control; compliance evidence stored in system
Buying and Quality modules for supplier evaluation, inspection, and approval

internal_external_issues.issue_title: Climate Change – Extreme weather events such as heat waves, floods, cyclones, heavy rainfall, drought, and other climate-related disruptions
internal_external_issues.description: Climate Change – Extreme weather events such as heat waves, floods, cyclones, heavy rainfall, drought, and other climate-related disruptions may affect the availability of raw materials, supplier operations, transportation networks, utilities (electricity and water), export logistics, and regulatory requirements related to environmental sustainability.
internal_external_issues.effect_on_qms: Delay in procurement of raw materials and consumables. Disruption in transportation and export shipments, resulting in delayed customer deliveries. Supply chain interruptions leading to production delays. Increased procurement, logistics and operating costs.
internal_external_issues.action_taken: Monitor supplier delivery performance and maintain approved alternate suppliers in ERP Next. Track procurement lead times and maintain safety stock for critical raw materials. Use Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and production planning modules to mitigate supply disruptions. Monitor customer delivery schedules and shipment status through ERP Next.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Recurring supplier dimensional nonconformities
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Dimensional NCRs concentrate in one supplier's brush holders; 12 NCRs recorded in 2026.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Nonconforming supplied parts reach production and delay orders.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Agree a joint inspection standard with the supplier; 100% incoming inspection for the next three lots; downgrade on recurrence.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Goods accepted without incoming inspection
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: 58% of receipt lines carry no Quality Inspection.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Unverified material enters stock and production, evidenced as a gap in REG-015.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: No acceptance without inspection: Quality Inspection on every receipt line, same day, before stock movement.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Measuring instruments without calibration plans
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: 33 assets exist with zero maintenance plans; instruments flagged 'needs calibration' with no dates.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Product acceptance decisions made with uncalibrated instruments; clause 7.1.5 exposure.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Create an Asset Maintenance plan per instrument with calibration tasks; work the monthly due list; certificates attached to logs.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Customer complaints handled informally
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Only 4 complaints logged in 2026 while resolution work is visibly happening.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Complaint handling leaves no evidence trail; REG-008 understates reality and trends are invisible.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Every complaint becomes an Issue the day it arrives, whatever the channel; monthly review of open complaints past 14 days.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Production planning concentrated in two people
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: The MD personally created 108 work orders and 620 job cards; planning knowledge sits with two individuals.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Absence of either person stalls planning; no documented handover.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Delegate work-order planning to the Production Lead per SOP-007; MD retains approval-level involvement only.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Quality management position unstaffed
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: No employee holds the Quality Manager / MR designation; 43 documents name it as approval authority and 16 SOP duties point at it.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Change control and quality duties have no accountable holder; segregation of duty depends on it.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Designate the Quality Manager / Management Representative and a deputy; assign the Internal Auditor role.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Fragmented user identities in evidence trail
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Three staff work under both company and personal email accounts; one employee record points at another person's address.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Approval stamps and record ownership split across identities; audit trail credibility weakened.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: One person, one identity: disable personal-email logins, correct employee-user links, close the unidentified account.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Competency records absent
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Zero Employee Skill Maps exist for 38 active employees; REG-006 prints headings over nothing.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Competence claimed in SOP-003 has no evidence behind it.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Create skill maps for desk staff first, then shop floor; competency evaluation joins hiring and role-change routine.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Nonconformities without corrective actions
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: 12 NCRs exist against zero Quality Actions; recurring causes are not being closed.
risks_and_opportunities.description: The register that shows nonconformities and no corrective actions audits itself; recurrence continues.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Raise a Quality Action for every recurring NCR with root cause, owner and target date; verify effectiveness before closure.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Internal audit programme not started
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Zero internal audits recorded; SOP-015 promises an annual programme.
risks_and_opportunities.description: A certification blocker: no first-party evidence that the QMS is checked against itself.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Quarterly audit rotating departments, recorded as Internal Audit with findings; first audit within the quarter.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Stores function without a formal holder
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: The person performing stores and incoming inspection has no employee record and two user accounts.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Six SOP duties assigned to a function with no formally designated person.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Create the employee record, one company account, and designate the stores responsibility.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Customer-driven design without defined control
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Customer-driven design occurs while the design SOP and register are parked with no system behind them.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Design work happens outside any controlled process; clause 8.3 scope position undecided.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Decide the clause 8.3 scope position; if in scope, implement BOM-based design control as planned.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Structured training and competency development
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Training events are already recorded in ERP; a structured calendar and competency link would compound them.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Competency-based development raises capability and satisfies clause 7.2 with evidence built in.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Publish the annual training calendar; every session a Training Event with attendance; link outcomes to skill maps.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Automated objectives measurement
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Quality Goals with scheduler-generated reviews are live; the measurement loop can run itself.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Objective performance evidence accrues automatically and feeds management review without transcription.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Owners work their generated Quality Reviews on cadence; failed objectives escalate to Quality Actions; MRM reads the results.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Registers derived from live ERP data
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: 26 registers print from live system data instead of hand-kept tables.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Audit-ready evidence with zero transcription effort; registers cannot drift from reality.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Hold the derivation-first rule for every future register; registers cite their data source on the printed page.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Controlled approved-supplier list
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Approval-status fields are specified and awaiting application; REG-007 then becomes a real controlled list.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Buying restricted to approved suppliers with recorded qualification, satisfying clause 8.4 mechanically.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Apply the supplier approval fields; qualify critical suppliers first; re-evaluation dates drive the annual review.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Batch traceability as a customer offer
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: 1,108 batches across 1,308 batch-tracked items: traceability practice is already strong.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Full trace documentation offered to customers as a differentiator at near-zero extra cost.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Standardise a per-order trace pack: batch chain, inspection records, certificate of conformity from the delivery note.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Institutionalised management review
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: MRM machinery is built: FRM-024 numbering, minutes guidance, linked reviews and actions.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Half-yearly reviews with linked evidence become routine rather than an annual scramble.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Standing half-yearly meeting; agenda from the dashboards; every action minuted with an owner and ToDo.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Dispatch documentation automation
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: Dispatch checklist and certificate of conformity are mapped to the Delivery Note.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Consistent dispatch documents generated from the transaction rather than assembled by hand.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Print dispatch checklist and CoC from the Delivery Note as routine; attach transport documents to the record.

risks_and_opportunities.title: Work instruction coverage for production sections
risks_and_opportunities.issue_description: 15 work instructions exist; extending coverage across production sections standardises operations.
risks_and_opportunities.description: Reduced operator-dependence and consistent output across shifts and sections.
risks_and_opportunities.action_required: Review WI coverage against the production register; write the missing instructions with operator involvement.

objectives.objective: Improve customer satisfaction (monitor feedback, timely complaint resolution)
Increase sales volume (market expansion, customer retention)
Achieve on-time delivery (production planning, delivery tracking)
Reduce internal process errors (process review, standardization)
Reduce product non-conformities (inspection, root cause analysis, corrective action)
Improve supplier performance (supplier evaluation, audits, corrective actions)
Improve equipment reliability (preventive maintenance, breakdown analysis)
Reduce unplanned breakdowns (scheduled maintenance, root cause analysis)
Improve employee competency (training programs, skill evaluation)
Reduce employee absenteeism (attendance monitoring, engagement initiatives)
Reduce employee attrition (employee engagement, career development)
Enhance continual improvement culture (identify and track improvement initiatives)
